name: PGR2 / original Xbox
purpose: Evidence and implementation guide for native adapters; not importable as a generic 9XD Mesh Profile.
status: Native indexed extraction, compact vehicle groups, WMSH base tracks and supported compact INST objects at source placements; command-based objects and stream assembly pending

container.compressedFraming: zlib sync-flush ending 0000ffff; no Adler trailer; non-final streams require the dedicated pgr-zlib-sync adapter

vehicle.positionScale: 32 * INFO.scale[axis] / 32767; INFO X at +16, Y/Z at +20
vehicle.drawTopology: independent triangle strips; skip degenerates; first LOD per group

track: WMSH, INST, GPUD, GPUS, VB and PAK_STREAM relationships remain to be reconstructed.

limitations: Five supplied indexed archives / 65 sections tested.
Declared decompression header is treated as bounded capacity; not assumed to equal actual output.
Never relax generic zlib checksum/termination validation for this framing.
Vehicle component/state alternatives remain separate; do not treat Select All as a fully resolved game vehicle assembly.
Texture/material IDs retained, pixels not yet assigned to vehicle groups.
Validated against the supplied 240Z only; additional vehicles still need corpus validation.

materialIntegration.MAT: UInt32 count; records Int16 texture ID, UInt16 color, UInt16 flags, UInt8 blend, UInt8 constant
materialIntegration.shaderPolicy: Conventional diffuse records assign textures; paint/environment flags (mask 0x0c) retain neutral surfaces with original texture IDs and material flags. Exact paint/glass/reflection shaders pending.
materialIntegration.validation: 240Z: 79 draws, 57 materials, 2 shared textures, 46 diffuse texture draws; geometry counts unchanged. Independent metadata audit: 84 indexed cars/200 TEXT entries use 0x040c; this is not full geometry validation of all 84.

wmshTrack.hierarchy: 0x83d branches with four relative children; 0x83f leaves with independent subdraws
wmshTrack.validation: Referenced positions must fit the leaf bounds; strips reset per subdraw; material-declared strides only.
wmshTrack.textures: TEX/GPUD BC1 and BC3; source effect inputs retained in library, not guessed as diffuse.
wmshTrack.tested: Barcelona day: 2644 materials, 364078 triangles, 1190 shared images; UI bulk load and GLB export. 34 of 35 area archives accepted structurally; one has no supported WMSH.

placedTrackObjects.source: Nested INST INFO/MESH prototypes and WMSH leaf matrix arrays
placedTrackObjects.matrixMetadata: Prototype reference in the low byte of element 0; color reference in element 6; clear packed metadata before transforming.
placedTrackObjects.geometry: Validated 0xc34/0xc35 compact strips with per-draw vertex offsets and material-declared layout. Other command layouts are not treated as ordinary strip tables.
limitations: Additional streams and original effect shaders pending

uvCorrection: Full track and compact INST UV0 precedes the optional normal field. Vehicle UV layout is separate. Building-to-building triangle report remains under investigation.
